# NOXEL Spectra

> NOXEL Spectra is a free, browser-based image toolkit: format conversion, compression to a target file size, dominant color palette extraction, PNG/WebP-to-SVG vectorization, and favicon package generation. Part of the NOXEL ecosystem alongside NOXEL SEO and NOXEL Forge.

## Tools

- [Convert & Compress](https://app.noxelspectra.com/): Convert images between JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF and GIF; compress to a manual quality level or an exact target file size in KB.
- [Resize](https://app.noxelspectra.com/): Resize images by width/height, with or without preserving aspect ratio.
- [Color Palette Extractor](https://app.noxelspectra.com/): Extract an image's dominant colors as hex codes with usage percentages.
- [Vectorizer](https://app.noxelspectra.com/): Trace a PNG or WebP logo into a multi-color SVG, with an editable color palette before tracing.
- [Favicon Generator](https://app.noxelspectra.com/): Generate a complete favicon package (favicon.ico, PNG sizes, Apple touch icon) from a single logo image.

## Learn

- [What is SVG?](https://app.noxelspectra.com/learn/images/image-formats/what-is-svg/): What SVG is, when to use it for logos and icons, and how it compares to PNG.
- [What is PNG?](https://app.noxelspectra.com/learn/images/image-formats/what-is-png/): What PNG is, its lossless compression and transparency support, and when to use it over JPEG or WebP.
- [What is a Favicon?](https://app.noxelspectra.com/learn/images/web-images/what-is-a-favicon/): What a favicon is, what sizes are needed, what favicon.ico is, and how to generate a full favicon package.
